patch.value: Justify the fragment size and chunking thresholds with reproducible benchmarks

DEFAULT_FRAGMENT_SIZE is 1 MiB and the chunking thresholds are chosen rather than measured. A constant copied from another system encodes that system's workload, not this one. The number should follow from a benchmark that can be re-run when the storage layer changes.

A TypeScript benchmark in this repository measures store size, write throughput and range-read cost across candidate fragment sizes on a reproducible corpus; the chosen default follows from its output and the reasoning is recorded next to the constant; the benchmark is runnable from an npm script so a later change can re-derive the number rather than inherit it
